A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SKD paper, with 31 readable pages including Appendices A–O. Pages 2–31 have identical text and rendered content; the limited first-page changes are fully comparable.

before.justification: v2 reports original distillation experiments for translation, summarization, arithmetic reasoning, and math instruction following, with benchmark results in Section 5 and additional experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original experimental results in Section 5 and the appendices, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and decoding-speed analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 are identical. Student proposals, teacher top-K acceptance and replacement, interleaved sampling, and the distillation objective remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Flores-200 Assamese-to-English, DialogSum, GSM8K, and UltraInteract data, with the same held-out MATH, GSMplus, ASDiv, and SVAMP evaluations. No task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments: SFT, supervised KD, on-policy KD, and ImitKD remain in Tables 1–2, and the two-stage supervised/on-policy comparison remains in Figure 5.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices D, G, and J retain identical model configurations, data splits, training budgets, checkpoint selection, decoding procedures, and evaluation metrics. No new evaluation protocol is introduced.

E4.justification: The K sensitivity and adaptation studies, initialization and low-data analyses, two-stage training ablation, case studies, decoding-speed tests, rejection-rate analysis, convergence plots, and OOD analysis are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Tables 1–2 retain the same permutation-significance reporting, including the p<0.05 threshold and stated exceptions. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting information is added or removed.

E6.justification: All reported numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains Gemma SKD scores of 75.3 COMET, 35.0 ROUGE-L, and 29.1 accuracy. Figure 1 uses identical underlying graphic content despite its resized display.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objective in Sections 2–3, divergence discussion in Appendix A, and computational assumptions and derivations in Appendix M are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about interleaved teacher–student sampling, improved distillation performance, robustness across settings, and speculative-decoding benefits.

C2.justification: Interpretations of sample quality, teacher–student distribution mismatch, and training transitions are unchanged. Qualifications concerning adaptive K, SFT overfitting, and incorrect early SKD reasoning samples also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the code-and-data link from github.com/xu1998hz/skd to github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/speculative_kd. This updates access instructions; implementation details and hyperparameters remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish either destination's accessibility or contents.

R1.justification: Section 6 and the bibliography are identical. Positioning relative to supervised KD, on-policy KD, imitation learning, and speculative decoding is unchanged.

P1.justification: Administrative text changes are limited to the repository address and the arXiv version/date stamp. The substantive prose, title, author list, section order, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: On page 1, the longer repository address accompanies abstract reflow and a slightly smaller, repositioned Figure 1. Its panels, labels, legend, and caption are unchanged. Pages 2–31 render identically.

improvement.justification: The scientific argument, experimental evidence, results, and appendices are unchanged. The repository-link update and small first-page layout adjustments leave overall quality essentially unchanged. Both versions already state that code and data are released; the PDFs do not demonstrate an additional reproducibility benefit.
